materialFinding: The current producer request supplies two item-specific optimizerInput concepts per Wall item, but the exact current artPromptOptimizer/artFactoryJob API has no path that consumes those optimizerInput strings during plan compilation. Running the current artFactoryJob plan CLI would silently replace the planner concepts with generic recommend() variants, so generation must not start from that output.

observedContract: recommend(item, review, model, count) constructs its own A-PHYSICAL/B-READABILITY/C-THEME-TIER/D-REPAIR variants from prompt blocks.
compose(item, blocks, variant, repairContext) has no optimizerInput/base-brief parameter.
The CLI recommend command accepts item and variant count, not a planner-supplied per-variant brief.
plan calls recommend(item, currentReview, model, variants) directly.
plan therefore cannot consume producerRequest.items[*].variants[*].optimizerInput or optimizerInputSha256.
plan-batch consumes queue.selected[*].promptRecommendation, but the current Wall producer request is not such a queue and contains no compiled promptRecommendation object.

whyThisBlocksGeneration: The producer request explicitly says each pinned base brief must pass through the existing artPromptOptimizer and that final generation prompt/hash must come from optimizer output.
Substituting generic recommend() output would discard the current bounded concept intent and would not consume the current request as directed.
Manually concatenating or rewriting the planner brief around the optimizer would fork prompt logic outside scripts/artPromptOptimizer.mjs, which this producer is not authorized to edit or bypass.
A generator call before resolving this contract would produce pixels without a compliant optimizer -> deterministic job lineage.
